description.en-US:
Blocks YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, X and Substack outside the hours you
allow. The filtering happens on the device: no proxy, no certificate, no account.
While it blocks, sites and hours are locked, and five maths problems can stand
between you and stopping it. Friction you choose, not parental control. Works on
IPv6-only carriers. Black and white, text only, six languages.

Only the names of the sites you look up pass through the app, never the traffic
itself. They go to your network's own name servers as usual; if those do not
answer, the app asks Quad9, a Swiss non-profit name service, so that the phone
keeps working.
